notes.title: What's new, right here
notes.text: When there's something new, a short summary like this one shows once a day. You can turn it off in Account.

notes.title: See who's signed in
notes.text: The bar under the header shows your name and your role in the team. Tap it to open your account.

notes.title: Why a team is read-only
notes.text: When a trial ends or a payment is overdue, the team says why it's read-only and what to do next. Nothing is deleted while it's read-only.

notes.title: Sheets are now projects
notes.text: Job sheets are called projects now. Everything on them is the same.

notes.title: Scan barcodes live
notes.text: Point your camera at a barcode and it reads it on the spot. No photo needed.

notes.title: Low-stock alerts
notes.text: Items at or under their reorder level are flagged for the whole team. Mark one seen, or mark it ordered with how many and when.

notes.title: Reorder levels in CSV files
notes.text: The inventory CSV import and export now include each item's reorder level.

notes.title: A brand for each item
notes.text: Items can have a brand. It's optional.

notes.title: Warning before a lapsed team is deleted
notes.text: If a trial or subscription ends and nobody subscribes, owners get emails with the date before the team is closed and deleted.

notes.title: Read receipts with a photo
notes.text: Take a photo of a receipt and the app reads its lines for you to check before they're added.

notes.title: Receipt scans left
notes.text: Each plan includes a number of receipt scans a month. The app shows how many are left before you scan.

notes.title: Find returned projects
notes.text: Search returned projects, grouped by year and month.

notes.title: Read-only after a trial or missed payment
notes.text: A team whose trial ended or whose payment is overdue can still be seen and exported, but not changed, until it's paid.

notes.title: Company equipment
notes.text: Track tools and equipment in inventory. They go out on a project and come back.

notes.title: Bill equipment bought for a client
notes.text: Equipment bought for a job can be billed to the client with a markup that owners set in Team settings.

notes.title: Equipment still out
notes.text: Finished Return asks about any equipment that hasn't come back yet.

notes.title: Take supplies without a project
notes.text: Quick take puts supplies on a General Use project, and you can return them from anywhere.
